Hi all — I completed a first-pass intake on the order form. High-level notes below and a small set of items we need clarified before redlines: 

1) Data processing/security: Order form references "customer data" but does not define categories (PII, payment data, logs). Please confirm which categories apply — we will map to our DPA exhibits accordingly.

2) SLA / credits: Section 3 (Availability) currently ties credits to "downtime" without definition of measurement window. Suggest defining uptime metric and exclusion list (maintenance windows, force majeure).

3) Payment terms: Net 30 is fine, but we need the billing entity name and EIN for invoicing. Ava — please confirm whether Redwood should invoice Redwood Inference, Inc. (US tax info on file) or a marketplace billing entity.

4) Liability cap: The draft leaves cap blank. Standard Redwood policy is lesser of $3M or 12 months fees for this tier; if Global Payments requests higher cap we’ll need to escalate to Legal Leadership.

5) IP/Derivative works: There’s a clause implying customer ownership of derivative outputs; need narrow language to preserve model IP and clarify license for customer outputs.

Please see the attached redline-questions summary for line-level references. I plan to prepare a redline file with tracked changes after we get (1) data categories confirmed and (2) billing entity details.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kimberly — good checklist. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

1) Data categories: primary scope is transactional payment data and anonymized usage logs; no raw cardholder data will be shared to Redwood. We will provide a specific data inventory doc on the drive link below.

2) SLA: we can accept a measurement window and will propose language for exclusions — Marc will draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

3) Billing entity: Please invoice Global Payments, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Marc, can you confirm billing address and tax paperwork?

4) Liability cap: We understand your standard but will escalate internally if a higher cap is required.

5) IP: We can accept a license-back for customer outputs limited to use of outputs for our internal business; will flag exact language for your redline.

Kickoff: Tue 10:00 AM PST works for us — sending calendar invite.
